issue: customer_id is generated per order, not per person
decision: Use customer_unique_id for all customer-level analysis

issue: Orders with no item rows (mostly unavailable / canceled)
decision: Excluded from revenue; kept in fact_orders with order_value = 0
Kept for revenue, excluded from delivery-time metrics

issue: Carrier pickup date earlier than purchase date (timestamp error)
decision: Carrier date not used in metrics; delivery time measured purchase -> customer delivery

issue: Sparse months: Sep-Dec 2016 (launch) and Sep-Oct 2018 (data cut-off)
decision: Trend analysis limited to Jan 2017 - Aug 2018 (20 full months)

issue: Orders with more than one review
decision: Keep the most recently answered review per order

issue: Orders split across several payment rows (e.g. card + voucher)
decision: Aggregated to one row per order; main payment type = the one with the largest value

issue: Payment total differs from item total by > R$1 (installment interest, vouchers)
decision: Revenue measured from items (price + freight) - consistent with category-level analysis
